questions.prompt: Four players limped. You have top pair on a dry board in position. Best default?

choices.text: Check because limped pots cannot be bet
Pot-size bluff with the same hand

questions.explanation: Top pair is ahead of a wide field. A small bet gets calls from worse without inflating a multiway pot.

questions.prompt: Same limped pot, you have ace-high and no draw, multiway. Best default?

choices.text: Check. Air does not bluff into four players.
Bet large because the pot was limped

questions.explanation: Multiway limped pots are for made hands, not for steals.

questions.prompt: You flop a set in a limped pot. Best default?

choices.text: Bet. Do not give a free card to a wide field.

questions.explanation: Sets want value from the many one-pair hands that limped.

questions.prompt: Bottom pair, limped, multiway, someone bets pot. You should…

choices.text: Fold. The size and the field are too strong for bottom pair.

questions.explanation: A big bet into a limped pot is more honest than a small one. Weak pairs fold.
